stages.name: scatter
stages.claim: with the source known, a large share of updates are exactly zero

stages.name: naive
stages.claim: averaging delta over d mixes those zeros in, so the fitted kernel comes out too weak

stages.name: gate
stages.claim: a latent gate z_e ~ Bern(pi): with probability pi agent i moves, otherwise it stays

stages.name: mixture
stages.claim: the update is a mixture of a mover and a stayer arm; a zero is explained by z_e = 0, not by a small kernel
